_bob.plan: W9t, docs/COMFYUI.md track B, pipeline step 5 (primary paint route)
_bob.purpose: PBR texture an existing mesh in its own UVs. Point it at a grey block-out proxy and it comes back textured.
deviations_from_source: GeomPackLoadMesh replaced by Trellis2LoadMesh, which takes a free-form path. The COMBO node lists the input/3d directory and comfy-env CACHES that scan, so a mesh Bob uploaded a second ago is not in the enum even across a server restart. Using the combo would make every first upload fail.

MaskPreview, GeomPackPreviewMeshDual, GeomPackSaveMesh and Preview3D-on-SaveMesh dropped. GeomPackSaveMesh writes through trimesh with no axis conversion and no UV V-flip, so its GLB comes into Blender rotated and with the texture upside down; Trellis2ExportTrimesh does both conversions and is the one kept.
Preview3D re-pointed at Trellis2ExportTrimesh's path string, so the written file's name reaches the job outputs.
BOB_* titles added on the templated nodes.
_bob.notes: The mesh MUST arrive unit-normalised. Trellis2EncodeMesh voxelises in unit-cube space, so a metre-scale mesh lands outside the grid, the encoder sees nothing, and the albedo comes back silently BLACK (G0.5 measured exactly this, 172 s for a black texture against 10 s for a correct one). core.gen_assets normalises on the way out and rescales on the way back, and the headless gate asserts the result is not near-constant.
